## Objective
- Fix the player fist positions, reduce attack damage, and add difficulty settings that adjust enemy count, attack strength, and damage dealt to the player.

## Requirements
- Build or update the playable game without asking clarifying questions.
- Make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them on completion.

## Decisions
- Added Easy, Normal, and Hard settings; Easy scales enemy count, attack strength, and player damage down, while Hard scales them up.
- Reduced player strike damage and rally damage.

## Work State
### Completed
- Updated `game.js` with difficulty selection, scaled wave sizes and incoming damage, lower player attack damage, and corrected fist placement and facing.
- Added difficulty selector styling in `style.css`.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` completed without errors.

### Active
- Changes are uncommitted; visual/gameplay verification has not been performed.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run the game and verify difficulty selection, wave counts, attack damage, and fist positions visually.
2. Report the implemented changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, combat, difficulty selection, and fighter drawing.
- `style.css`: Difficulty selector styling.

## Important Context
- Normal is the default difficulty.
- Player damage values changed from 22/34 to 14/22; rally damage changed from 32 to 20.
- No screenshot was captured.
